servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read/write access to a restricted set of directories. The default argument (".") allows the dsh working directory — edit the row to list the roots you want to expose.
servers.descriptionZh: 受控目录的读写访问。默认参数 "." 只放开 dsh 工作目录，安装后可编辑该行，列出你要开放的具体目录。
servers.detail: Read/write access to the directories you list as arguments. Every file operation is a separate tool call (read_file, edit_file, directory_tree...), so the model sees exactly what changed. Edit the row after install to replace the default '.' with the roots you want to expose.
servers.detailZh: 对参数中列出的目录进行读写。每个文件操作都是独立工具调用（read_file、edit_file、directory_tree 等），模型能精确看到每处改动。安装后编辑该行，把默认的「.」换成你要开放的具体目录。

servers.name: Memory
servers.description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory across sessions (entities, relations, observations).
servers.descriptionZh: 跨会话的持久知识图谱记忆（实体、关系、观察）。
servers.detail: A persistent knowledge graph stored as JSONL: entities, relations and observations accumulate across sessions. Good for long-running projects where the agent should remember decisions, people and facts without re-reading transcripts.
servers.detailZh: 以 JSONL 持久化的知识图谱：实体、关系与观察跨会话累积。适合长线项目，让 agent 不必重读记录就记得决策、人物与事实。

servers.name: Sequential Thinking
servers.description: Dynamic, reflective problem-solving through structured chains of thought.
servers.descriptionZh: 通过结构化的思考链进行动态、反思式的问题求解。
servers.detail: A single tool that lets the model externalize its reasoning: revise earlier thoughts, branch into alternatives, backtrack when a line of reasoning dead-ends. A token-cheap way to improve multi-step reasoning quality.
servers.detailZh: 只有一个工具，让模型把推理过程外化：可修改前文思路、分支探索、走不通时回退。提升多步推理质量的低成本手段。

servers.name: Everything
servers.description: Reference server exercising every MCP feature — prompts, resources, tools, sampling. Handy for verifying a client setup.
servers.descriptionZh: 覆盖 MCP 全部能力的参考服务器——提示、资源、工具、采样，适合验证客户端配置。
servers.detail: The MCP reference server that exercises every feature: prompts, resources, tools, sampling, notifications. Not useful for real work; use it to verify a client or transport setup end to end.
servers.detailZh: MCP 官方参考服务器，覆盖全部特性：提示、资源、工具、采样、通知。不适合干正事，用来端到端验证客户端或传输配置。

servers.name: Git
servers.description: Operations on local Git repositories: status, diff, branches, commits, tags.
servers.descriptionZh: 操作本地 Git 仓库：状态、差异、分支、提交、标签。
servers.detail: Read-mostly Git operations on local repositories: status, diffs, branches, log, plus commit/push/pull. Safer than a shell for routine Git questions because the tool surface is bounded; runs via uvx (needs Python/uv).
servers.detailZh: 对本地仓库的 Git 操作，以读为主：状态、差异、分支、日志，外加提交/推送/拉取。相比直接开 shell，工具面收窄更安全；经 uvx 运行（需要 Python/uv）。

servers.name: Serena
servers.description: Semantic code intelligence over language servers: find symbols and references, read and edit precise ranges instead of whole files.
servers.descriptionZh: 基于语言服务器的语义代码工具：找符号与引用，按精确范围读写而非整文件。
servers.detail: A free, local alternative to hosted coding agents: Serena wires LSP language servers into MCP so the model navigates code semantically — find_symbol, find_referencing_symbols, read or edit a function's body — token-efficiently on huge codebases. Configures languages on first run; served over uvx from git.
servers.detailZh: 托管式编码 agent 的免费本地替代：Serena 把 LSP 语言服务器接进 MCP，让模型按语义导航代码——找符号、找引用、只读写函数体——在超大代码库上省 token。首次运行自动配置语言；经 uvx 从 git 拉取运行。

servers.name: Fetch
servers.description: Web content fetching and conversion, optimized for LLM usage.
servers.descriptionZh: 网页内容抓取与转换，面向 LLM 使用优化。
servers.detail: Fetches a web page and converts it to clean Markdown sized for LLM context; respects robots.txt. The go-to tool when the model needs to read one URL without spinning up a browser.
servers.detailZh: 抓取网页并转成适合 LLM 上下文的干净 Markdown，遵循 robots.txt。模型需要不开浏览器读一个链接时的首选工具。

servers.name: SQLite
servers.description: SQLite database access with schema inspection and query analysis. Edit the row's --db-path argument after installing.
servers.descriptionZh: SQLite 数据库访问，支持结构检查与查询分析。安装后可编辑该行的 --db-path 参数。
servers.detail: Direct SQL against a SQLite file: read queries, schema inspection (list/describe tables) and an insights log. Edit the row's --db-path argument after installing to point at your database.
servers.detailZh: 直接对 SQLite 文件执行 SQL：读查询、表结构检查（列表/描述）与洞察日志。安装后编辑该行的 --db-path 参数指向你的数据库。

servers.name: Time
servers.descriptionZh: 当前时间查询与时区转换。
servers.detail: Current time in any IANA timezone and conversion between zones with proper DST handling. Solves the classic 'agent thinks it is yesterday' problem.
servers.detailZh: 按 IANA 时区查当前时间并在时区间换算，正确处理夏令时。专治「agent 以为还是昨天」这类经典问题。

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Repositories, issues, PRs, and more. Requires a personal access token in the environment after install.
servers.descriptionZh: 仓库、Issue、PR 等操作。安装后需在环境变量中填入个人访问令牌。
servers.detail: The official GitHub MCP server: issues, PRs, reviews, branches, file contents, code/issue/repo search. Needs a personal access token in GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN; the token's scopes decide what it may touch.
servers.detailZh: GitHub 官方 MCP 服务器：Issue、PR、评审、分支、文件内容、代码/Issue/仓库搜索。需要在环境变量 GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN 里填个人访问令牌，能碰什么由令牌 scope 决定。

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Web/local/image/news search via the Brave API. Requires a Brave API key.
servers.descriptionZh: 通过 Brave API 进行网页/本地/图片/新闻搜索，需要 Brave API 密钥。
servers.detail: Web, news, image and local search through the Brave Search API — an independent index, not a Google/Bing reseller. Register at brave.com/search/api for the free tier and put the key in BRAVE_API_KEY after install.
servers.detailZh: 经 Brave Search API 的网页/新闻/图片/本地搜索——独立索引，不是 Google/Bing 的转售。到 brave.com/search/api 注册免费档，装好后把密钥填进 BRAVE_API_KEY。

servers.name: Tavily
servers.description: LLM-oriented search, extraction, crawling and site mapping via the Tavily API. Free tier available; key goes in TAVILY_API_KEY.
servers.descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 的搜索、抽取、爬取与站点地图（Tavily API）。有免费额度；密钥填在 TAVILY_API_KEY。
servers.detail: A search stack built for agents: tavily-search returns LLM-ready synthesized results, tavily-extract pulls clean content from URLs, tavily-crawl walks whole sites and tavily-map returns a site's page structure. A popular default for giving an agent web research. Register at tavily.com for a free key.
servers.detailZh: 专为 agent 打造的搜索全家桶：tavily-search 返回适合 LLM 直接用的合成结果，tavily-extract 从 URL 抽干净正文，tavily-crawl 爬整站，tavily-map 给出站点页面结构。给 agent 配联网调研能力的流行默认选择。到 tavily.com 注册可得免费密钥。

servers.name: Puppeteer
servers.description: Browser automation: navigation, screenshots, clicks, form fills, JS evaluation.
servers.descriptionZh: 浏览器自动化：导航、截图、点击、表单填写、JS 执行。
servers.detail: Drives a real Chromium: navigate, screenshot, click, fill forms, evaluate JS. A full browser stack with no site-specific logic; for accessibility-tree-driven automation see the Playwright entry instead.
servers.detailZh: 驱动真实 Chromium：导航、截图、点击、填表、执行 JS。纯浏览器栈、无站点适配逻辑；要基于无障碍树的自动化请看 Playwright 那条。

servers.name: Playwright
servers.description: Microsoft's official browser automation MCP: drives a real browser through the accessibility tree — navigate, click, type, screenshot — no vision model needed.
servers.descriptionZh: 微软官方浏览器自动化 MCP：经无障碍树驱动真实浏览器——导航、点击、输入、截图——不需要视觉模型。
servers.detail: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP. The model interacts with pages via the accessibility snapshot rather than screenshots, so it is fast and works headless; the managed browser is one browser_install away. Tab management, console and network inspection, file upload and dialogs are first-class. The modern default for web automation.
servers.detailZh: 微软官方 Playwright MCP。模型通过无障碍快照而非截图与页面交互，速度快且可无头运行；托管浏览器一条 browser_install 就装好。标签页管理、控制台/网络检查、文件上传与对话框都是一等公民。当下网页自动化的默认选择。

servers.name: Chrome DevTools
servers.description: Google's official DevTools MCP: drive Chrome with snapshots, clicks and forms, plus performance traces, console and network inspection.
servers.descriptionZh: Google 官方 DevTools MCP：快照、点击、表单驱动 Chrome，附带性能 trace、控制台与网络检查。
servers.detail: From the Chrome DevTools team: page automation via accessibility snapshots (navigate, click, fill, evaluate) plus the DevTools-native superpowers — CPU and network performance traces, console messages, network request logs. Pick it when you are debugging a slow page rather than automating it.
servers.detailZh: Chrome DevTools 团队出品：经无障碍快照自动化页面（导航/点击/表单/执行 JS），外加 DevTools 看家本领——CPU/网络性能 trace、控制台消息、网络请求日志。调试慢页面（而非纯自动化）时选它。

servers.name: Context7
servers.description: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.
servers.descriptionZh: 获取各类库与框架的最新版本文档与代码示例。
servers.detail: Pulls up-to-date, version-pinned documentation for any library: resolve-library-id finds the doc set, get-library-docs returns topic-scoped pages with code examples. Stops the model answering from stale training data.
servers.detailZh: 为任意库拉取最新且锁版本的文档：resolve-library-id 定位文档集，get-library-docs 返回带代码示例的按题取材页面。防止模型用训练数据里的旧 API 答题。
